name: Myon
maker: Humboldt University of Berlin, Neurorobotics Research Laboratory
def: Modular humanoid from Berlin whose limbs can be detached and keep working, built for research on distributed neural style control.
body: Myon is about 1.25 m tall and weighs roughly 15 kg, with each body part carrying its own power supply, processing and actuation so a single arm or leg still functions once removed. Control runs across a distributed network of small processing nodes rather than one central computer, which suits experiments in sensorimotor learning and self exploration. The robot took a singing and acting role in the opera My Square Lady at the Komische Oper Berlin in 2015.
facts: Limbs can be removed and continue operating on their own power
Performed in the opera My Square Lady at the Komische Oper Berlin
specs: Modular electric actuator units, one set per body part
Distributed neural style control across per limb processing nodes
